objects.name: Analytic 2245
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) field device event logs being cleared via ICS protocol commands from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, occurring immediately following other suspicious ICS activity on the same device. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: NSM:Content
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: event buffer clear or log clear service from source not in engineering workstation list, correlated with preceding suspicious activity on the same device

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Allowlist of processes/accounts authorized to delete or truncate ICS application logs.
Time window prior to a log-clear event within which other suspicious activity is considered correlated.
Documented schedule for legitimate, automated log rotation/archival.
